scientific.integrity: The complete-bipartite specialization is treated as previously covered and is not the originality-bearing part. The claim concerns ordinary domination, not independent or total domination. The earliest verified public source date is the first arXiv posting of the foundational domination-polynomial paper on 2012-06-26, rather than its later journal publication date.
limitations: The theorem is restricted to finite connected chain graphs in canonical nested-neighborhood form.
The exhaustive checker covers order at most 11; the unrestricted theorem is established by the symbolic boundary-index proof.

Targeted searches did not locate an earlier equivalent ordinary-domination formula for chain/Ferrers/difference graphs, but historical terminology and incomplete indexing leave a residual bibliographic risk.

title: Exact domination polynomial of chain graphs
